# SheetJS Community Edition source attribution

- Project: SheetJS Community Edition
- Source: https://git.sheetjs.com/sheetjs/sheetjs
- Package: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz
- Version: 0.20.3
- License: Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE` in this directory)

EduPi Desktop uses SheetJS on the local server to read teacher-selected CSV, TSV, XLSX, XLS, XLSM, and XLSB roster files. Workbook bytes remain on the local machine and are converted into the existing bounded student import contract.
